#   capability-ids comma list, "-" for none. Ids are the D section 5 seeds; "area.*" names stay until G1 lists them.
#   junit-classes  comma list of surefire -Dtest patterns (slash form), "-" for none, FULL for the whole suite.
#   autoqa-ids     comma list for tools/ops/autoqa-run: check ids or family short ids (bl, cb ...), SMOKE for the
# A path with NO matching row is unknown: it broadens to the full unit suite plus the smoke set. Nothing is dropped
# silently. A ticket that adds a test adds its row here (ticket rule, plan C). P1-C1a's map/portal/script validator
# gets its own row when it lands.
